decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (L140165-109A, L140165-301A, L140165-101A received 12/05/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted and other associated structures shall be removed from the site within 2 years of the date of this permission. Within 3 months of removal [or in the first planting season] following removal of the mobile classrooms, the land shall be reinstated to a quality at least equivalent (or better) than the previous quality.
description: Removal of two existing temporary classroom buildings and installation of a new two-storey temporary building containing four classrooms and support spaces.
